First moves — water damage

    Services

    Three kinds of damage. One crew to call.

    Every job starts the same way: stop the damage from spreading, remove what's ruined, dry or clean what's left, and put the space back together.

    Water Damage Restoration

    Burst pipes, appliance leaks, storm flooding, and sewage backups. Standing water spreads and soaks into walls and floors fast — extraction and structural drying stop it from becoming a mold problem next.

    • Water extraction & pumping
    • Structural drying & dehumidifying
    • Moisture checks in walls & floors
    • Sanitizing after sewage or flood water

    Fire & Smoke Restoration

    After the fire is out, soot and smoke keep damaging surfaces and lungs. Cleanup removes debris and soot, treats odor at the source, and gets the space safe to rebuild.

    • Debris removal & cleanup
    • Soot removal from walls & contents
    • Smoke odor treatment
    • Air scrubbing & ventilation

    Mold Remediation

    Mold follows moisture — a slow leak, a damp basement, an old flood. Remediation contains the area, removes the growth safely, and addresses the moisture source so it doesn't come back.

    • Containment of the affected area
    • Safe removal of moldy material
    • HEPA air filtration during the work
    • Moisture-source fixes to prevent return
